headline: Sirius Real Estate Half-Year Profit Drops 60.8% on Borrowing Costs
summary: Sirius Real Estate reported a 60.8% decline in half-year profits as elevated financing costs and property valuation adjustments offset rent growth.
why: Sirius Real Estate operates major industrial and business parks in Germany and the United Kingdom.

impacts.name: Sirius Real Estate
impacts.why: Profitability fell sharp due to higher debt servicing expenses.
